title: ModelEntry

id.description: The model's id, as a run or a session names it.

family.description: The model's family (opus, sonnet), which accounts.defaultModelFamily names.

tier.description: An ordinal the adapter supplies: higher is stronger; a family it cannot place ranks below every known one.

efforts.description: The reasoning efforts the model takes, weakest first; empty when it takes none.

label.description: The model's name as a client shows it, when the adapter gives one.

contextWindow.description: The context window only when the provider reports it; absent for static catalogue entries.

description: One model of an account's catalogue: its id, family, ordinal tier and efforts.
